description: semanticCommits: this repository writes Conventional Commits subjects itself, so Renovate follows the same convention.

packageRules.description: Workflows name actions by version tag and .github/workflows/actions.lock pins each to a commit. Renovate regenerates the lockfile with its action updates and would turn the digests config:best-practices pins back into version references.

The Check workflow runs these actions and tools on the pull request itself, so their majors merge once checks pass. attest and create-github-app-token run only on a tag push, which no pull request exercises.
A golangci-lint or actionlint release can report new issues; in a group of their own, a failure blocks only them.
Renovate leaves the go directive alone by default. Bumping it keeps the toolchain that setup-go installs, and that builds the release, on current security fixes.
MyGo builds the window and the app bundle, which no check renders, and a 0.x minor can change its UI API. Upgrading it follows .agents/skills/mygo-maintenance, so it waits for review on its own.
